title: Who a PMS distributor is: NISM XXI-A, APRN and EUIN
objectives: Name the certification and registration required.
Describe the client's direct onboarding option and our value.
body_md:
- Must clear the NISM Series XXI-A (PMS Distributors) certification.
- Must register with APMI and hold an APRN (APMI Registration Number). Since 31 July 2025, distributors without an APRN cannot bring in new PMS business or receive commission.
- Employees of non-individual distributors also need an EUIN.
- Earns trail commission only; upfront commissions and upfront fees to clients are not permitted.
- Clients can always choose direct onboarding with the portfolio manager, with no distributor, so our value must be clear.

> **Investor takeaway:** PMS gives you a concentrated, transparent portfolio in your own name, but needs ₹50 lakh and more tolerance for swings.

say: You can onboard directly with the manager. Here is what we add: strategy comparison, monitoring and reviews.
My APRN and EUIN are on every document, and our trail commission is disclosed.
never: You must go through us to invest in PMS.

check.q: What does a PMS distributor need before dealing with PMS clients?
o: NISM Series XXI-A and an APRN from APMI
check.why: Employees of non-individual distributors also need an EUIN. Since 31 July 2025, no APRN means no new business or commission.

check.q: How is a PMS distributor paid?
o: Upfront commission on each new client
An upfront fee charged to the client
A share of the manager's profit fee
check.why: Upfront commissions and upfront fees to clients are not permitted.

check.q: What happens to a PMS distributor without an APRN after the cut-off date?
o: They cannot bring in new PMS business or receive commission
check.why: Without an APRN, a distributor cannot bring in new PMS business or receive commission.
